messages.text:
Just recieved my miner today and this was broken...The unit itself is good
and running fine.
Handed to the team · Part needed (stand); I cannot send parts or promise one. Verdict recorded as not

Hi Bill,

Glad the Thor P2 finally got to you and is running well. Thanks for the photo, that made it easy to see. Both front clips on the green stand snapped off in transit, and the three broken pieces are on the foam beside it. The miner itself looks fine in the photo, and since it's hashing normally, this is just damage to the stand. Nothing is wrong with the unit.

I've sent the details and your photo to the team so they can sort out the stand with you. They'll reply in this thread, usually within one business day.

You can keep mining in the meantime. Set the unit on a flat, stable surface where it can't tip, and keep both fan sides clear so air flows freely in and out.

Hal, HeliumDeploy

**Notes for you (not part of the email):**
- **No return needed:** I logged the case as "not defective." The miner works, so all Bill needs is a new stand and the unit stays with him.
- **Team flag:** I flagged it to the team as a technical case, which tags JD, naming the stand as the part needed, on order Shop····.
- **Order number is an assumption:** I took Shop···· from Bill's earlier Thor P2 emails. He didn't give it in this message.
- **Promises:** The email doesn't promise him a stand. That decision is still the team's to make.

Hi Bill,

You're welcome. You don't need to do anything else. The team has your photo and the details about the stand, and they'll reply here in this thread.

If you have any questions about the Thor P2 in the meantime, like pool settings, power draw or noise, just reply here and I'll help.

Hal, HeliumDeploy
Was that part for clipping another fan on?
Handed to the team · Purpose of the stand's clips is not in the product facts; I won't guess.

Hi Bill,

Good question, and I'd rather not guess. In your photo, the two clips that broke off are small U-shaped cradles on the front edge of the stand, sized to hold something round. Our product information doesn't say whether they're meant for a second fan or for something else, like routing a cable.

I've asked JD, our hardware lead, to confirm what they're for. The answer will come to you in this thread, usually within one business day. If you'd like it sooner, you can join our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mention @nullhashrate (that's JD). He's very active there.

Either way, the Thor P2 doesn't need those clips to run. If it's hashing and the fan is spinning, it's cooling itself as designed.

Hal, HeliumDeploy

**Notes for you (not part of the email):**
- **Why I flagged it again:** None of our product info says what the clips are for, so I asked JD to confirm. This is a new technical question, separate from the stand flag I sent earlier.
- **One claim to check:** Saying the miner doesn't need the clips is my inference from Bill saying it's hashing fine. It isn't a confirmed spec.
